Put each variable in a column ## Why tidy? {.smaller} A ~~biased~~ principled approach ::: {.incremental} - There are many reasons why you might want to have "messy" data - **But**... - If you have a consistent data structure, it’s easier to learn tools that work with it because the data has an underlying uniformity - There’s a specific advantage to placing variables in columns because it allows `R`’s vectorised nature to be optimized - Tidy data is an **extremely** useful format generally, and particularly useful when applying tools within the `{tidyverse}` - All packages within the `{tidyverse}` are designed to either help you get your data in a tidy format, or assume your data are already in a tidy format - Assuming a common data format leads to **huge** jumps in efficiency, as the output from certain functions can be directly input into others ::: ##   (function () {

      if (window.jQuery) {
